Hornets 124Cavaliers 112

Allen and Reid end Charlotte's skid

Final · Mon, Nov 9 · Charlotte

Charlotte beat Cleveland 124–112, a 12-point home win. The Hornets move to 4–7; the Cavaliers fall to 5–6.

1 of 7 · The verdict

Won it from three and on the glass.

Threes made 23–14; rebounds 49–32. Charlotte made 23 of 46 threes.
